answer: Each AI receives a per‑identity seed hashed into a “violet” provenance tag that is bound to a cryptographic nonce stored on a glacier‑cold ledger; the ledger also records a marble‑hard proof‑of‑stake stake of 5 tokens that must be locked for 48 hours before the tag becomes usable. When an agent submits a transaction, the network verifies that the tag’s nonce matches the stored seed and that the stake is still locked, rejecting any duplicate tag from a new identity.
